_comment: C16 code-agent sandbox sizes. ONE source per provider: every size is built from that provider's single Dockerfile by build-sized-templates.mjs; only cpu/memory differ. Keep grid equal to DEFAULT_SANDBOX_GRID in back-end/src/providers/codeSessions/sandboxSize.ts (pinned by src/tests/structural/sandbox-size-templates.test.ts). Memory stops at 8 GB: the E2B team refuses templates over 8192 MiB; 16 GB needs E2B support to raise that cap.
